profile.name: TOPTICA iBeam 智能二极管激光器
profile.description: TOPTICA iBeam 是一款紧凑型智能二极管激光光源，可通过串口控制激光开关和输出功率，并读取实际输出状态。它常用于显微镜激发照明、光学实验以及需要稳定连续激光输出的实验室场景。
profile.description_en: The TOPTICA iBeam is a compact smart diode laser source with serial control for laser on/off operation, output power setting, and status readback. It is commonly used for microscope excitation, optical experiments, and other laboratory applications requiring stable continuous laser output.
